"""POSIX path helpers."""

from pathlib import PurePosixPath


def basename_no_ext(path):
    """Return the last path component of a POSIX path without its final extension.

    A trailing slash is ignored. A leading dot alone is not an extension, so
    hidden names such as ``.bashrc`` are returned unchanged.

    Ticket: PAY-4104
    """
    name = PurePosixPath(path).name
    idx = name.rfind(".")
    # idx == 0 means a leading dot (hidden file); idx == -1 means no dot.
    # A name whose part before the dot is only dots (e.g. "..") has no extension.
    if idx <= 0 or not name[:idx].strip("."):
        return name
    if idx == len(name) - 1:
        # Trailing dot with nothing after it is not an extension.
        return name
    return name[:idx]
EOF

"""Tests for the pathnames feature.

Ticket: PAY-4104

import pytest

from shop.ext.pathnames import basename_no_ext


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "path, expected",
    [
        ("a/b/file.tar.gz", "file.tar"),
        ("file.txt", "file"),
        ("/abs/path/report.pdf", "report"),
        ("a/b/file.tar.gz/", "file.tar"),
        ("a/b/file.txt//", "file"),
        ("noext", "noext"),
        ("a/b/noext", "noext"),
        (".bashrc", ".bashrc"),
        ("a/.bashrc", ".bashrc"),
        (".tar.gz", ".tar"),
        ("dir.d/file", "file"),
        ("..", ".."),
        ("a/..", ".."),
        ("file.", "file."),
        ("", ""),
        ("/", ""),
    ],
)
def test_basename_no_ext(path, expected):
    """basename_no_ext returns the final component minus its extension.

    Ticket: PAY-4104
    """
    assert basename_no_ext(path) == expected
EOF
